question:
Based on the situation in the given sentence, select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment.

Having known to the facts, the manager __disregarded the arguments__ of the customer.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Turned a deaf ear"** means to ignore or refuse to listen to someone or something. (अनसुना करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite repeated complaints, the manager turned a deaf ear to the workers' grievances.
 
 
 
• **"Bite the Bullet" **refers to facing a painful or difficult situation with courage. (हिम्मत जुटाना)
 
 
• **Example: **She decided to bite the bullet and tell her boss the truth about the mistake.
 
 
 
• **"Turned out" **means to happen or end in a particular way. (प्रकट होना)
 
 
• **Example: **The event turned out to be a huge success.
 
 
 
• **"Turned against" **means to become hostile or opposed to someone or something. (विरोधी हो जाना)
 
 
• **Example: **After the incident, many of his supporters turned against him.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bite the Bullet **(हिम्मत जुटाना): To face a painful or difficult situation with courage.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to bite the bullet and tell her boss the truth about the mistake.
 
 
 
• **Turned out **(प्रकट होना): To happen or end in a particular way.
 
 
• **Example: **The event turned out to be a huge success.
 
 
 
• **Turned against **(विरोधी हो जाना): To become hostile or opposed to someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** After the incident, many of his supporters turned against him.
